headline: Nvidia's Jensen Huang scheduled to testify before Senate on December 3
summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang is scheduled to testify publicly before senators on December 3, following his reinstatement as CEO. TechCrunch reports the public hearing follows bipartisan calls for Huang to testify about his affair with a suspected Chinese spy.
